title: IPO Montenegro in Budva 2026: financial education and fraud prevention
summary: Educational snapshot on cross-border risks, fraud prevention, and digital awareness.
body_text: As part of prevention-oriented updates, we highlight IPO World Congress 2026 in Budva.
